offering_description.value: Manufactures and markets spices, herbs, seasoning blends, condiments and flavor ingredients. Sells branded consumer products to grocery retailers and flavor solutions to food manufacturers and restaurant chains. Produces in its own plants from globally sourced raw ingredients.

primary_products.value: spices and herbs; seasoning blends; condiments and sauces; flavor ingredients; extracts

customer_segment.value: B2B: food manufacturers, restaurant chains, foodservice operators, grocery retailers; B2C: household consumers buying spices and seasonings at retail

end_markets.value: consumer packaged foods; grocery retail; restaurants and quick-service; food manufacturing; foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded spices, seasonings, condiments sold to retailers, flavor ingredients sold to food companies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes sourced spices, herbs and ingredients into blends and flavors for retailers and food companies; brand owner: owns and markets consumer spice and condiment brands sold to grocers

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific including China

specialization.value: related lines: consumer spices and seasonings plus flavor solutions for food manufacturers and foodservice

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery stores, mass merchants, club stores; direct sales: food manufacturers and restaurant chains; online: e-commerce retailers and own web store; distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; direct sales; online; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and labeling rules from FDA, USDA and international authorities
